{{Quote|This is a prison planet. Worthless. And yet for some reason, the Empire has taken a keen interest in the area.|[[Arnecio Ulvaw'op]]|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] '''invaded''' the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Although Imperial forces defeated the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], they were finally forced to renounce to the planet and abandon all their troops on the surface.

==Prelude==
Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a presence on the remote planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. While [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was aware of the presence of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Witches of Dathomir]], he allowed the construction of a [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|prison]] on the planet.<ref name="GatORW" /> Imperial troops initially encountered no resistance from the Witches,<ref name="Insider" /> and focused their efforts in hunting the [[Kwi]] that were brought to near extinction.<ref name="GatORW" />

==The battle==
[[File:dathprison.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Dathomir Imperial Prison]].]]
When the construction of the Imperial prison was completed, it was not long before the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], a sect of evil Dathomiri Witches, approached the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. Their leader Gethzerion offered the services of her clan to control prisoners. Although the commander was quite suspicious about her true intentions, he finally accepted her offer. Gethzerion and her dark minions thus became a familiar sight in the Imperial compound.<ref name="TDSS" /> Using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], the Nightsisters began to [[Mind trick/Legends#Force corrupt|corrupt]] the Imperial troops and progressively usurped control of the prison staff from Imperial officers.<ref name="Insider" />

When the Imperial commander discovered the situation, Gethzerion and the Nightsisters turned Imperial troops against their officers. A battle therefore erupted on Dathomir between loyal Imperial forces and the Nightsisters backed by their Imperial [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Eventually, the Nightsisters were defeated and repelled from the prison.<ref name="Insider" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The planet's name is Dathomir. It seems the planet holds many Force users of great power. However, the Emperor found it first - he's blockaded the planet and placed a nightcloak generator system in orbit.|[[Urai Fen]]|<ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>}}
As the Emperor realized that Gethzerion and the Nightsisters were more powerful than what he expected, he ordered the Witches of Dathomir to be confined on their planet.<ref name="TDSS" /> Shortly after the Battle of Yavin, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zsinj]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] the Imperial prison from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], destroying every vessels parked there to prevent the Nightsisters to leave Dathomir.<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> All communication equipment present on the planet was also destroyed.<ref name="Insider" /> Dathomir was [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by Imperial starships with strict orders to never land on the planet.<ref name="TDSS" /> The prison and all Imperial forces at the surface were abandoned.<ref name="GatORW" /> These troops continued to fight the Nightsisters for years,<ref name="Insider" /> but they eventually became slaves for Gethzerion and her dark followers.<ref name="GatORW" />
